profile_text.body:
Founders Fund is a venture capital firm based in San Francisco, California, founded in 2005. Its website describes it as investing in companies building revolutionary technologies. The firm operates for profit, and its site notes that Founders Fund is a registered trademark of Founders Fund, LLC. The site also carries standard disclaimers that past performance is not indicative of future results, that investments may lose value, and that nothing on it constitutes an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy securities.

No AI products or MCP servers are tracked for the firm. Its litigation exposure is recorded in California, with 281 cases.
